#
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    UI->>+FastAPI: POST file meta info (who and what)
    FastAPI->>+DB: Puts meta info into
    FastAPI->>+ UI: Generated Url by which UI can upload file
    UI->>+Blob Storage: Uploads file with this url
    Blob Storage->>+FastAPI: POST with file info
    FastAPI->>+Redis: message with file info
    Redis->>+Celery: message with file info
    Celery->>+Blob Storage: downloads file
    Celery->>+Celery: parses file and do <br/> neccesary cheks
    Celery->>+DB: Stores info about errors in file or Success
    UI-->>DB: Checks if file was processed

# file upload meet
First case pros/cons:

+ very fast to implement, that's why can be a temp solution
+ editing in local excel files are fast and user friendly for those who knows how to work with Excel



Second case:

- requires table interface implementation on Back and Front ends (we will implement it anyway for data editing further)
+ when editing table via our UI table interface we can prevent user of inserting wrong data types on the fly
